THE_TACTICAL_NON_TRIGGER: NOT ARMED, and the reason is structural rather than discretionary: the confirmation clause is UNCOMPUTABLE 8 minutes into a session. It requires a candidate bar measured against a TRAILING 30-60 MINUTE baseline (2026-08-25T16:05Z) that must ALSO not sit materially below the session's own established bucket rate (2026-08-26T15:52Z) -- and at 13:38Z neither denominator exists. Per the 2026-08-25T17:22Z rule a trigger whose numbers cannot be re-derived off the same window has not been tested, only quoted. Additionally the opening hour inflates every volume baseline (~2.1x the post-first-hour rate on the measured session), so any ratio computed now is knowingly wrong in a direction that MANUFACTURES confirmation.
